- Calories: start 10..12 kcal per lb bodyweight; adjust by 150..200 kcal every 2 weeks to target 0.5..1.0% bodyweight loss/week.
- Protein: 1.0 g per lb goal bodyweight (or 0.7..0.9 g per lb current), 3..5 meals/day, 25..45 g per eating occasion.
- Carbs: 0.8..1.2 g per lb goal bodyweight; prioritize low-GI, high-fiber sources; bias carbs pre/post workouts and earlier in day.
- Fats: fill remaining calories from unsaturated fats; limit saturated; avoid trans fats. Fiber 25..35 g/day. Hydration 2.0..3.0 L/day unless contraindicated.
- Weekly Flex Meal:
  - 1 meal/week on a lifting day (marked "+ Flex Meal Day"), not before fasted cardio. Keep protein >=30 g, veggies included. Size ~600..900 kcal depending on body size.

- Fasted Cardio (Type 2 Diabetes on metformin):

  - Hydrate; carry quick-acting carbs; stop if dizziness/weakness.
- Intermittent Fasting (TRE):
  - Gradual progression: 12:12 to 14:10; optional 16:8 up to 3..5 days/week if SMBG stable and workouts fueled. Keep resistance sessions inside eating window. Do not exceed 16h fasts. Break fast for symptoms or SMBG <80 mg/dL.
- Pre-workout options on fasted-cardio days (if needed due to low SMBG):
  - 10..20 g carbs + 10..20 g protein: small apple + cheese stick; 1 slice whole-grain toast + 1 egg; 1/2 banana + 6 oz greek yogurt; protein shake (20 g) + 1/2 banana.
- Quick post-workout snacks (25..35 g protein + 20..40 g low-GI carbs; lower-carb if post-exercise glucose high):
  - Greek yogurt + small apple; protein shake + 1/2 banana; cottage cheese + berries; tuna pouch + whole-grain crackers; turkey slices + baby carrots + hummus; skyr + chia; string cheese + small pear; 2 hard-boiled eggs + small whole-grain wrap; edamame + clementine; reduced-sugar chocolate milk if tolerated.
- Safety:
  - Avoid training if fasting glucose >300 mg/dL with symptoms; hydrate and consult provider. Monitor SMBG with new/harder sessions; aim pre 90..130 mg/dL, post <180 mg/dL.
- Supplements (if cleared by provider):
  - Creatine monohydrate 3..5 g/day, vitamin D if deficient, omega-3 if dietary intake is low.
